summary: Add receipt-file and audit-dir to blockedRootFlags so MCP callers cannot choose filesystem destinations.
reason: Both flags reached the child CLI through the MCP root-flag filter. audit-dir drives os.MkdirAll plus receipt and index.jsonl writes at a caller-supplied path using the MCP server's privileges. They are the same class as deliver, which the generated list already blocks for exactly this reason; they appear to have been overlooked. Receipts are an operator concern, not an agent tool parameter, so blocking them costs no legitimate MCP capability. Raised as a P2 security finding by Greptile on library PR #1723; the gap is in the generator template and affects every printed CLI.
validated_outcome: go build and go vet pass; live dogfood reran at 121 passed / 0 failed; the two flags now sit alongside deliver in blockedRootFlags.
